description: This file defines a payload structure for gateway setup and provides functionality for decoding such payloads from JSON or Base64-encoded strings.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a raw string into a GatewaySetupPayload object by trying JSON decoding or Base64 decoding.

methods.name: decodeFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a GatewaySetupPayload object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Payload
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string into its original string representation.
